heroTagline: Seven kingdoms. Seven sacred animals. One dying crown — and a secret old enough to unmake them all.
cosmologyHeading: Seven kingdoms, bound by ancient seals
cosmologyText: Each kingdom is aligned to an animal spirit and a philosophy of power. When those seals weaken, kingdoms do not fall equally. Some fracture. Some wait. And some remember.
sealsHeading: Seven crowns. Seven seals. One Watcher.
sealsText:
Every kingdom of K'Thari is bound to its sacred animal, and every bond is sealed — the lion, the elephant, the hyena, the serpent, the gorilla, the leopard, and the crocodile. Above them all, belonging to none, the Owl keeps watch.

While the seals hold, the kingdoms endure. When they weaken, something older than every crown begins to stir.
bookText:
The Oracle is dead. The Unifier falls. The Age of One Crown ends. As the ancient seals that bound the seven kingdoms weaken, an evil old enough to remember their making stirs beneath the waiting waters.

Told in the spirit of ancestral storytelling and built on African cosmology and oral tradition, *The Seven Kingdoms of K'Thari* is the epic fantasy the genre has been missing — the first book of a planned twelve-volume saga.
authorText: Born and raised in Cameroon and based in Florida, Njintieuh Sieni grew up on stories told aloud — history, warning, and wonder passed down by voice. That oral tradition is the DNA of K'Thari: an epic fantasy world he is building to live across page, screen, and memory.
quote: "When truth is spoken too late, it becomes prophecy."
ctaText: Begin the saga today — and be first to know when Book II arrives.
